items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to perform wonders before Pharaoh when returning to Egypt, and promised to harden Pharaoh's heart to prevent him from releasing the people.
